displayPattern: Multi display on an LG front-load washer-dryer combo after a drying cycle: Cd
meaning: Cool down: LG says Cd is not an error. The drying cycle has finished, and the combo tumbles the load so wrinkles do not set, for up to 4 hours.
causes: The drying cycle has finished and cool down started on its own
Clothes were left in a washer-dryer combo after the dry cycle
diySteps: Cd is not a fault to clear. Cool down is set automatically when the drying cycle ends
The drum periodically tumbles, rearranges and fluffs the load for up to 4 hours so wrinkles do not form
The message stays until the clothes are removed, or until START/PAUSE is pressed
A wash-only LG washer does not use this dry-cycle display. If the machine has no drying cycle, check the code against the list again
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Do not request a repair because Cd is on the display after a dry cycle. Remove the clothes or press START/PAUSE. This is the washer-dryer combo behavior on LG's front-load list, not a wash-cycle fault.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
